Forwarding this along from Abebe's office so nobody says they didn't get it. Coffee and donuts will be in the break trailer at the Route 9 yard for whoever's on site, and the call-in's below for the rest of you out on jobs. If you're pouring that morning, don't you dare leave a crew standing around for this. Just grab the notes later from your super. 🍩☕

Bianca

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Abebe Ahmadi
Subject: Company All-Hands
When: Thursday, 7:00 AM – 7:30 AM
Where: Route 9 Yard, Break Trailer / Dial-in: [conference line]
To: All Achterberg Construction Staff (50)

Team,

Please plan to join us Thursday morning for a company all-hands. Ivan Kowalczyk and Jonas Mbatha will be there, and Kavya Ekwueme will say a few words on behalf of the estimating group. Zoe Varga from the office will run the call-in for folks in the field, and Femi Jaramillo will have the sign-in sheet for safety credit.

We'll keep it to thirty minutes and get everybody back to work. If you can't make it, let your foreman know.

Thanks,
Abebe

---

P.S. from me again: I asked whether this was about Project Kiln and all I got back was "you'll see" 🤷. So I can't tell you what it's about.
